evidence.reason: `gitLsRemoteRef` concatenates stdout and stderr at line 819 and then parses the combined string as the ref listing. A successful `git ls-remote` can still emit warnings to stderr; if the ref exists, stdout's trailing newline plus stderr makes line 827 throw "matched multiple refs", and if the ref is absent, stderr makes line 826 fail to return null and line 831 throws "returned no commit oid". This is an implementation defect in the existing intended behavior.
